sloka: श्रिया ज्वलन्तीस्त्रपयोगूढा ।निशीथकाले रमणोपगूढाः ।ददर्श काश्चित्प्रमदोपगूढा ।यथा विहङ्गाः कुसुमोपगूढाः ॥५-५-१८॥
transliteration: śriyā jvalantīstrapayogūḍhā ।niśīthakāle ramaṇopagūḍhāḥ ।dadarśa kāścitpramadopagūḍhā ।yathā vihaṅgāḥ kusumopagūḍhāḥ ॥5-5-18॥

translations.english: There he saw cheerful demonesses shining brightly, abashed by the embrace of their beloveds during the night. He also saw those sporting with their beloveds freely and looking like birds embracing flowers.
